name: Mori Kumi
source:
Kumi Mori is a student in class four who is the most puerile, yet politest friend of Otome. In the anime, it is mentioned that she has a boyfriend. Kumi also bullies Kotonoha.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_School_Days_characters#Cross_Days_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]

May be related to [url=/c15390]Mori Misao[/url] from Miss Each Other.
